recruiterCard.summary: Built a market-signal platform that ingests live data, ranks equities, and explains predictions with calibrated evaluation and interpretable outputs.
impactBullets: Built a FastAPI backend ingesting live market data, generating ranked equity signals, and serving SHAP-backed explanations.
Implemented evaluation pipelines with ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier scores, and calibration curves for model reliability.
Designed reproducible feature workflows and regime-aware backtesting for evidence-based model selection.
